acceptance: visible >=20 and >=5%; tracked coverage >=80%; bbox >=20%; foreign old family overlap diagnostic only; other-seed overlap diagnostic only
whole_retirement: all selected targets reliable; this old observation spatially contained; union protects other seed objects
partial_retirement: remove only original family pixels covered by reliable target foreground; preserve all other original pixels and their shared supports
allowed_set: removed observation surface supports union accepted new surface supports
vote_unit: one vote per frame, surface point and persistent ID
tracking: offline independent seed-only forward and reverse states; full raw sequence
confirmation_and_postprocessing: unchanged native rules and assignment settings
retirement_protection: unchanged: other-seed union overlap may downgrade whole retirement to partial, but does not reject the new mask
